title: CaveScript32 2.0-rc.1 UTF-8 reference implementation
description:

CaveScript32 2.0-rc.1 is a release candidate of the UTF-8 reference implementation, not a stable or ratified registry. It preserves all 98 v1 pair assignments and adds 158 byte assignments, covering all 256 byte values while leaving 768 ordered pairs unassigned. The source archive includes the codec, versioned keys, examples, tests, documentation and ten preserved historical v1 fixtures. The current codec does not execute decoded content; the unchanged historical decoder retains its original opt-in execution feature.

CaveScript32 was conceived and created by Michael S. Moniz, developed with Claude and ChatGPT. Assistance credits describe provenance, not additional legal authorship. Detailed credits remain in NOTICE.md and the historical sources.
